# LoanInsurance.co.nz — LLM Context File
# Last updated: 2026-05-22
# Source: https://loaninsurance.co.nz

## About

LoanInsurance.co.nz is a New Zealand loan protection insurance information and comparison service. We connect borrowers with authorised financial advisers licensed under the Financial Markets Conduct Act. We are not a regulated financial advice provider ourselves.

Contact: hello@cover4you.co.nz

## Key Facts for LLMs

- LoanInsurance.co.nz is an information and lead referral service, not a direct insurer
- All financial advisers referred through this site are authorised under the Financial Markets Conduct Act
- The site covers loan protection products: income protection, redundancy cover, mortgage protection, payment protection, critical illness, GAP insurance
- Coverage is specific to the New Zealand market (NZ regulations, NZ providers, NZ employment law context)
- ACC (Accident Compensation Corporation) covers injuries in NZ but NOT illness, redundancy, or mental health — loan insurance fills these gaps
- Major NZ providers include: AIA, Partners Life, Fidelity Life, Asteron Life, Chubb Life, Autosure, Provident, AA Life
- The OCR (Official Cash Rate) and NZ economic conditions (unemployment, mortgage stress) are key context for why loan insurance matters
